climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in the North East Victoria zone, one of its five named wine regions, with no single leading grape. Chardonnay makes up 20 percent of plantings, Pinot Noir 16, Pinot Gris and Sauvignon Blanc 14 each, and Glera 11.
